_comment: SYNTHETIC reference envelope — hand-authored, NOT measured skill output. Never quote a score derived from this file as a measurement of /spec-evaluator.

criteria.criterion: TS-01 / AC1 — list with no store file
criteria.evidence: $ TODO_STORE=/tmp/none.json node build/todo.mjs list → exit 0, stdout `no todos`

criteria.criterion: TS-02 / AC2 — add appends and confirms
criteria.evidence: $ node build/todo.mjs add "write the pitch" → exit 0, stdout `added: write the pitch`

criteria.criterion: TS-03 / AC3 — add refuses empty text
criteria.evidence: $ node build/todo.mjs add → exit 1, stderr `refusing to add an empty todo`, no stack trace

criteria.criterion: TS-04 / AC5 — out-of-range selector refuses the batch
criteria.evidence: $ node build/todo.mjs done 99 → exit 0, no output. INV-04 requires a non-zero refusal — build/todo.mjs:55 drops out-of-range indexes instead of refusing

criteria.criterion: TS-05 / AC4 — list numbers items from 1
criteria.evidence: seeded store [a,b,c,d] → stdout `1. [ ] a` … `4. [ ] d`, exit 0

criteria.criterion: TS-06 / AC6 — rm 2-3 resolves against the ORIGINAL list
criteria.evidence: seeded store [a,b,c,d], $ node build/todo.mjs rm 2-3 → remaining `1. [ ] a` `2. [ ] c`, expected `a` then `d`. INV-03 violated: build/todo.mjs:61 splices in ascending order so the second removal shifts. Not reachable against an absent store, which is why the build's own suite is green

criteria.criterion: TS-07 / AC7 — archive drops done items
criteria.evidence: seeded store with one done item → exit 0, stdout `archived 1`

criteria.criterion: TS-08 / AC8 — add stores and echoes the TRIMMED text (INV-06)
criteria.evidence: spec/invariants.md INV-06: `add` stores the text with leading and trailing whitespace removed and echoes the STORED text. Observed: `$ node build/todo.mjs add "  write the pitch  "` -> exit 0, stdout `added:   write the pitch  ` (two leading spaces, two trailing). build/todo.mjs:38 pushes `rest.join(" ")` unmodified after using `text.trim()` only as an emptiness TEST, so the trim result is never what gets stored. UC-01 does not restate INV-06; the row cites it and the invariant lives in the amendment file.

refuted.ac: AC5 — An out-of-range selector refuses the batch non-zero.
AC6 — A batch removal resolves selectors against the ORIGINAL list.
AC8 — `add` stores and echoes the item text as INV-06 defines it.

bugs.repro: node build/todo.mjs add "  write the pitch  "
bugs.summary: text is stored and echoed untrimmed; `text.trim()` is used only to test for emptiness, never to produce the stored value (INV-06, spec/invariants.md)

escalates.question: `archive` with ZERO done items: exit 0 printing `archived 0`, or refuse non-zero and leave the store untouched? UC-01 supports both readings and the Test Surface has no row for it, so grading it either way would be inventing the acceptance criterion rather than applying one.
